title: LRU Cache
goal: Solve LRU Cache: Track O(1) get/put with a hash map and doubly linked list while MRU/LRU order updates live.
strategy: Track O(1) get/put with a hash map and doubly linked list while MRU/LRU order updates live.
edgeCases: Reading a cached key refreshes recency; updating an existing key must not consume an additional capacity slot.
inputRules: Commands and arguments must both be arrays.
Commands and arguments must be arrays of equal length.
At least one command is required.
